en-IE.name: DART Times
en-IE.summary: Live DART departures from any station, from Irish Rail real-time data.
en-IE.description: Ask for the next DARTs from any station on the Dublin Area Rapid Transit line, optionally northbound or southbound. Save favourite stations and just ask when your next train is. Data from the Irish Rail real-time API.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask dart times when's the next train from Connolly
Alexa, ask dart times when's my next train
